lines.en: We ate our sandwiches behind a big rock, with a beautiful view over the valley.

lines.sv: På vägen ner ramlade Elin och slog sig i knät.
lines.en: On the way down Elin fell and hurt her knee.

lines.sv: Vi kom tillbaka till byn klockan fem, trötta men glada.
lines.en: We got back to the village at five o’clock, tired but happy.

questions.question: How long did the path go uphill?
choices: All the way to the village.
questions.explanation: “Stigen gick uppåt i två timmar”

questions.question: What was the weather like at the top?
questions.explanation: “På toppen var det väldigt kallt och det blåste hårt.”

questions.question: What happened to Elin?
choices: She hurt her knee at the top, in the snow.
She got lost behind a rock.
She was too tired to reach the top.
She fell on the way down and hurt her knee.
questions.explanation: “På vägen ner ramlade Elin och slog sig i knät.”

questions.question: How did they feel at the end of the day?
questions.explanation: “trötta men glada.”

lines.sv: Utflykt till Sandhamn: vi träffas klockan nio framför turistbyrån.
lines.en: Trip to Sandhamn: we meet at nine o’clock in front of the tourist office.

lines.sv: Båten går från hamnen halv tio och kommer tillbaka klockan fem.
lines.en: The boat leaves the harbour at half past nine and comes back at five o’clock.

lines.sv: Biljetten kostar tvåhundra kronor för vuxna och hundra kronor för barn.
lines.en: The ticket costs two hundred kronor for adults and one hundred kronor for children.

lines.sv: Ta med en tröja, för det är ofta kallt på båten, även i augusti.
lines.en: Bring a jumper, because it is often chilly on the boat, even in August.

lines.sv: Om det blir storm ställs utflykten in och du får pengarna tillbaka.
lines.en: If there is a storm, the trip is cancelled and you get your money back.

questions.question: Where does the group meet?
choices: In front of the tourist office.
At the harbour, on the boat.
questions.explanation: “vi träffas klockan nio framför turistbyrån.”

questions.question: How much does a child pay?
questions.explanation: “hundra kronor för barn.”

questions.question: Why should you bring a jumper?
choices: It often rains on the island.
It is often chilly on the boat.
The café on the boat is cold.
questions.explanation: “för det är ofta kallt på båten”

questions.question: What happens if there is a storm?
choices: The boat leaves later the same day.
The trip is cancelled and you get your money back.
The tickets are valid on another day.
questions.explanation: “Om det blir storm ställs utflykten in och du får pengarna tillbaka.”
